title: Readiness Estimator: Global Pair Programming
definition: Estimates Global Pair Programming readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Global Pair Programming components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a pair hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Global Pair Programming Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Global Pair Programming operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Global Pair Programming installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 26972 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where shared cursors monitoring, pair logistics redundancy, or latency hiding maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Global Pair Programming Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Global Pair Programming: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Global Pair Programming — pair programming across the planet in real time.

Phase 1 — Prove (shared cursors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pair logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (latency hiding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (presence cues): pair hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
